title: DeepSeek Promotes Feature to Build AI Agent Plugins Using Plain Language
summary:
The maker of the free DeepSeek Harness app is highlighting "Creator Mode," a tool that allows its users to generate functional add-ons by describing the desired tool in plain text. Once a user submits a request for a feature, such as a timer or a video-editing panel, the AI agent writes, installs, and tests the new plugin directly within the application.

While the lauch of the feature occurred in August, DeepSeek released a demo video and the prompts used for 7 specific use cases on Nov. 2 to encourage wider adoption. The tool is part of the open-source Harness project, which has gained 268.7K stars on GitHub from potential developers.

selectedTweets.text:
DeepSeek is promoting Creator Mode, that lets its open-source Harness agent build working plugins from plain-language requests.

Creator Mode is a setting inside DeepSeek Harness, DeepSeek’s free AI agent app, where you describe a tool you want (say, a timer or a video-editing panel) and the AI writes, installs and tests it as a new add-on inside the app. 
The feature has existed since August; today DeepSeek released a demo video and the prompts behind its 7 examples.

Harness’s 268.7K GitHub stars supply potential plugin builders, yet the ecosystem grows only if generated plugins work beyond curated demos.
